# CRM updater setup

Initial request: Build an agent that updates CRM contact records from my recent email threads each day.

Displayed trigger: Daily
Trigger guidance: Runs once a day on a schedule.
Treat this trigger text as setup guidance only. Do not activate an automation unless the user asks for it and confirms its exact settings.

Connection choices:
- `read-the-threads` (required): Read the threads. Options: gmail. Read recent email threads
- `land-the-updates` (optional): Land the updates. Options: hubspot, salesforce, attio. Land the updates
